about.en: The Orcolat is the giant of Friulian tales who sleeps in a cave under the mountains of Carnia (Monte Amariana, above Tolmezzo): when he turns over in his sleep, the earth shakes. Told gently for a child, ending with the Friulians rebuilding together after the great earthquake (1976). Machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker.

text.it: Nelle montagne della Carnia dormiva un gigante. Si chiamava Orcolat. Era grande, grandissimo. Dormiva sotto le montagne da tanti anni.
text.sl: V gorah Karnije je spal velikan. Ime mu je bilo Orcolat. Bil je velik, ogromen. Že veliko let je spal pod gorami.
text.en: In the mountains of Carnia a giant was sleeping. His name was the Orcolat. He was big, enormous. He had been sleeping under the mountains for many years.
text.de: In den Bergen von Karnien schlief ein Riese. Er hieß Orcolat. Er war groß, riesengroß. Er schlief schon seit vielen Jahren unter den Bergen.

text.it: Quando russava, il vento cantava tra i monti: frrr, frrr.
text.sl: Ko je smrčal, je veter pel med gorami: frrr, frrr.

text.de: Wenn er schnarchte, sang der Wind zwischen den Bergen: frrr, frrr.

text.it: Ma a volte l'Orcolat si girava nel letto. E allora la terra tremava! Le campane suonavano da sole: din, don, din! La terra tremava solo un po'. Poi l'Orcolat si addormentava di nuovo.
text.sl: Ampak včasih se je Orcolat v postelji obrnil. In takrat se je zemlja stresla! Zvonovi so zvonili kar sami: bim, bam, bim! Zemlja se je stresla samo malo. Potem je Orcolat spet zaspal.
text.en: But sometimes the Orcolat turned over in bed. And then the earth shook! The bells rang by themselves: ding, dong, ding! The earth only shook a little. Then the Orcolat fell asleep again.
text.de: Aber manchmal drehte sich der Orcolat im Bett um. Und dann bebte die Erde! Die Glocken läuteten von allein: bim, bam, bim! Die Erde bebte nur ein bisschen. Dann schlief der Orcolat wieder ein.

text.en: That is why people talked quietly at night: 'Shh! Let's not wake the Orcolat!'
text.de: Darum sprachen die Leute nachts leise: „Pssst! Wir wollen den Orcolat nicht wecken!“

text.it: I vecchi della Carnia raccontavano che sotto le montagne dormiva un gigante enorme, l'Orcolat. Dormiva in una grotta profonda, grande come una chiesa, sotto il monte Amariana.

text.en: The old folk of Carnia used to say that an enormous giant slept under the mountains: the Orcolat. He slept in a deep cave as big as a church, under Monte Amariana.
text.de: Die Alten in Karnien erzählten, dass unter den Bergen ein gewaltiger Riese schlief: der Orcolat. Er schlief in einer tiefen Höhle, so groß wie eine Kirche, unter dem Monte Amariana.

text.it: Quando russava, i boschi tremavano un pochino. Ogni tanto, però, l'Orcolat si girava dall'altra parte. Allora la terra tremava e le campane suonavano da sole.
text.sl: Ko je smrčal, so se gozdovi malo tresli. Vsake toliko časa pa se je Orcolat obrnil na drugo stran. Takrat se je zemlja stresla in zvonovi so zvonili kar sami.
text.en: When he snored, the woods trembled a tiny bit. Every now and then, though, the Orcolat turned over onto his other side. Then the earth shook and the bells rang by themselves.
